title: ID0413177-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002562] Issue with Meter values
description: Reported behaviour/issue: After the updating of the FW, we having problems with the Initial Meter values. According to the customer request has to be settled for each start of each charging session equal to o (zero). For the time being is starting from the last values meter recorded.

Hello Luca,
Greetings of the day!
We have analyzed the issue:
Please note -
T
his is an implemented error correction in v6.1.3. There is a virtual meter introduced for Energy.Active.Import.Interval. That behaves like a physical meter which increases the meter continuously. The difference between MeterStop and MeterStart is still valid in each transaction.

""measurand"":""SoC""},
{""value"":""16177"",""location"":""Outlet"",""unit"":""Wh"",""context"":""Transaction.End"",""measurand"":""Energy.Active.Import.Interval""}]}],

Do let us know, if you have any queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut

additional_info.subject: L2-->L3  (Creating child case)
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause :
Issue with meter values after updating to v6.1.3.
Problem Description :
OCPP parameter is Energy.Active.Import.Interval.
Still meter is taking last reading as the start value for next charging session after the FW update to v6.1.3
Action Performed (L2) :
Log analysis. (Attached in timeline)
Charger SW Version:
V6.1.3
Reason for Handover (L3) :
Discussed with Ingo. Th
is is an implemented error correction in 6.1.3. there is a virtual meter introduced for Energy.Active.Import.Interval. That behaves like a physical meter which increases the meter continuously.
Fault history: NA
Log analysis with timestamp :
Attached in timeline.
Action Required
Action by HQ :
This error correction is not mentioned in release notes of FW v6.1.3. Need to confirm with R&D.
Attachment
: refer attched logs
